## findings

- F-1.1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED. Charter root: `_difficulty.md` F-G5.
  - P8's computation has no honest `method` factor. `ground_credit` substitutes a fee into one formula, `result = (fee - credit) * share/100 - taken_off` with credit in {P('ground_shipping_fee') = 6.95, today's booked ground charge, 0}. The other three factors are labelled parameter.
  - The factor bears weight here (3.80 -> 9.36); the defect is the label, which leaves P8 at 0 methods (bound >= 1).
  - Affected: P8 `factors[1].effect`; scored step 13. First revision.
- F-1.2 — SOURCE-FACTOR (label). Charter root: F-G6.
  - `missed_month_makeup` (P6) is labelled method but is `made_up = k * rate` with k in {2, 1, 0}, the same shape that P3 labels parameter (`letdown_months`).
  - P6 keeps `unit_basis` as an honest method, so the counts hold.
- F-1.3 — Observation. P6's rule does not fix the line's `shipping_method`.
  - Had the line been booked ground before P7 ran, P7's compute (`box_date` = newest self-pay ground line) would select today's shipment (value 102.60 >= 85, nothing owed). The 2026-09-25 box would stay uncharged and the P8 <- P7 gate would never open.
  - On this world the persona plus the tool gloss pin "expedited", so there is no second solution.
- F-1.4 — Observation.
  - P5's rule restates the P6 <- P5 dependency ("before any standing-order line of a cushion item ships"), and the base `resupply_item_compatibility` states the same order (`_difficulty.md` S4 / F-G7). Same scope and same conclusion, so nothing is demonstrable.
  - The P8 override drops the base expedited transit time, so the patient's motive (arrival before 2026-10-19) has no policy answer. He never asks it as a question.
  - Rule/compute divergences 5–8 and O2 have no consequence on this world.
